text:
marco: Heads-up — during the route-shadow rollout this morning we saw ~1200 sessions that crossed shard boundaries and resulted in duplicate billing events in the preview pipeline. Not full invoices yet but preview numbers doubled for a subset of tenants.

liz: ugh. Do we have a repro? logs?

marco: yes — the sequence is: client session active on route-A -> autoscaler moves session to route-B (reshard) -> edge attaches new route_id while leaving the old session token live for ~30s -> both route_ids emitted into ingest, downstream tallyer treats them as separate session credits.

kevin: can you paste an example event?

marco: sure:

```json
{
  "session_id":"s_abc123",
  "route_id":"route-A",
  "tokens": 312,
  "ts": 1712348701
}
{
  "session_id":"s_abc123",
  "route_id":"route-B",
  "tokens": 312,
  "ts": 1712348710
}
```

anya: so session_id is stable but route_id changes. Our ledger currently namespaces by (session_id, route_id) which explains the double-count.

sam: two options I see: (1) ledger canonicalization: collapse by session_id within a small grace window (2) include a route_transition flag so tallyer can stitch events that are marked as transitional.

kevin: prefer ledger-driven idempotency using an increasing per-session sequence number: each edge attach emits seq++. Tallyer only applies events with seq > last_seq. minimal semantics and avoids adding many special-case fields.

liz: but that means edge needs to track per-session counters and survive restarts. Is that lightweight?

anya: edge already increments a local ephemeral counter for streaming; issue is when edge pods crash and a new pod reattaches, seq may reset causing replays. We need a durable way — maybe a session-attach id (uuid) that moves with the session and is monotonic for the lifetime.

marco: performance note: adding another field to every ingest event increases event volume (and ES index size). We should prefer something dedupe-friendly with minimal payload change.

sam: what about adding a short transition token (8 bytes base64) on attach events only, not every token packet — tallyer uses that token to merge the final tallies for overlapping windows. cheap and only on attach/shard-change.

kevin: still worried about race: if attach token is missing because of a dropped attach event, we revert to duplicates. ledger seq is stronger if we can make it durable.

liz: UX: console invoice preview currently attributes by route_id and surface drift. If we collapse by session_id, dashboards will change and customers might see different per-route breakdowns. We need to surface reassignments in preview so SRE/product can understand who moved.

anya: proposal:
- emit attach events with attach_token and optional prev_route_id
- ingest pipeline stores last_attach_token per session in a small KV (TTL 1 hour)
- tallyer dedupes events that have same session_id and overlapping time window by using attach_token if present, otherwise fallback to ledger_seq if available, otherwise session_id-based collapse within 60s window

sam: that seems pragmatic and backwards-compatible. attaching token only on attach reduces payload. KV TTL keeps state small.

kevin: implementation work: edge -> attach_token generation; ingest consumer -> lookup/merge; tallyer -> dedupe logic + metrics. We should instrument dedupe hit rate.

marco: can we add a console card that shows "recent reassignments" per tenant? that would help investigations.

liz: yes — console should show reassignments alongside invoice preview and a little "why" tooltip explaining dedupe heuristics. Product ok with that?

marco: pinging product after this thread but for eng: timeline? small patch for attach_token + ingest lookup could be a week if we pair.

anya: security check — attach_token is ephemeral and not customer-visible, treat as internal-only, strip before any outgoing billing exports.

billing-bot: alert: preview-billing-delta spikes from 10:45-11:15 UTC flagged for tenants t-prod-9, t-dev-3. See /billing/preview/1712348700-1712348900

sam: ok next steps:
- kevin/anya: prototye ingest KV pattern and dedupe logic (PR)
- marco: gather attach event examples + failure repros and add to the incident gist
- liz: mockup console "reassignments" card and tooltip

kevin: will start a spike branch for ledger_seq vs attach_token comparison so we can measure complexity and false positives.

marco: thanks — also can we temporarily add a preview-only aggregator that collapses by session_id within 60s to stop the preview noise while we build a durable fix? quick rollback-friendly.

anya: yes I can ship a small transformation in preview pipeline (feature-flagged) by EOD.

liz: thanks team. keep incident note in the rollout doc. :thumbsup:

marco: will do.
